ownerMapping.fit: Water evidence and comparisons fit the current owner; draft adds question routing and evidence distinctions only.

retainedMechanisms: Separate water questions into system choice, operating schedule, constrained supply, drainage, capture/storage, and water-quality concerns.
Confirm intended use, source, supplied observations, and decision context before analysis.
Expose the next measurement or qualified review when evidence is insufficient.
rejectedMechanisms: All universal numerical values for soil organic matter, water holding, schedules, crop-stage demand, deficit irrigation, drainage dimensions, costs, catchment ratios, water-quality thresholds, and treatment rates.
Deterministic soil-biology, yield, drought-resilience, and infrastructure-payback claims without local evidence.
Named authorities and uncited narratives as sufficient site-specific evidence.
Instructions to install or alter irrigation, drainage, dams, swales, or chemical treatments.
Routes to unavailable companion skills and output templates that imply unsupported advice or costs.
sources.reason: The water-topic taxonomy and confirm-before-analysis pattern are distinct and can be retained after removing unsupported numerical prescriptions and dependencies.
sources.remainingBoundary: Not agronomic, hydrologic, engineering, water-safety, treatment, irrigation-scheduling, or drought-allocation advice.

ownerMapping.fit: Mapped survey information versus field measurement is the strongest transferable boundary.

retainedMechanisms: Label soil-survey values as mapped estimates and preserve source, coverage or scale, map unit, horizon, units, and date when available.
Keep mapped values distinct from field and laboratory measurements; seek local sampling or qualified interpretation when needed.
rejectedMechanisms: USDA Soil Data Access endpoint, coordinate submission, API workflow, Python and plotting dependencies, and reproducibility bundle.
US-only service coverage as a product-wide assumption.
Automated soil classification and unsupported crop-management interpretation.
sources.reason: The source is a platform-bound lookup adapter; only its mapped-versus-site-specific evidence caveat extends the current owner safely.
sources.remainingBoundary: No live lookup, soil classification, soil test, crop suitability assessment, or treatment recommendation is made.

ownerMapping.fit: The existing owner covers crop, season, weather, stage, and observations; draft adds calculation traceability.

retainedMechanisms: Record crop or cultivar, site, dates, weather source, units, method, and source of parameters for any authorized calculation.
Keep calculated totals separate from modeled and observed stages.
Expose missing or conflicting weather records and compare estimates with field observations.
rejectedMechanisms: Hard-coded base and ceiling temperatures, stage thresholds, frost dates, planting windows, or biological claims.
Automatic unit detection, unqualified averaging assumptions, and interpolation defaults.
The source labels its calculation modified-sine but presents an arithmetic-mean expression; neither conflicting method is adopted.
Open-Meteo API, coordinate lookup, Python packages, plots, and generated bundles.
sources.reason: Traceable inputs and missing-data controls are useful, but the parameter values and calculation method are not sufficiently supported or internally consistent for adoption.
sources.remainingBoundary: No phenology, frost, planting-date, yield, or weather-service accuracy is established.

synthesis.decision: Author one small reference draft as an extension proposal to agricultural-observation-and-trial.
